scope: Local Chromium, real browser WebRTC operations with fake capture and local relay; no physical camera, hosted WebRTC or forced-relay acceptance claim.

negativeControls.operation: Hold initial hello decryption until a newer camera-on advertisement has been applied.
negativeControls.observed: Late hello overwrote current AV state; guest decoded host video while host video stayed zero for fifteen seconds.

negativeControls.operation: Hold older camera-on decryption until a newer camera-off advertisement has been applied.
negativeControls.observed: Releasing the older publication restored one stale peer tile despite the guest having stopped capture.

negativeControls.operation: Release a real remote answer and valid subsequent offer together while native answer application is pending.
negativeControls.observed: The impolite endpoint ignored the valid offer before native setRemoteDescription and left the other endpoint waiting for an answer.

fix.stateOrdering: Independent name and AV receive ordinals per live relay peer preserve newer wire-order state across delayed decryption.
fix.negotiation: Per-PC pending-answer state recognizes a valid subsequent offer and resets on success or failure.

earlierCiStartupFailureCause: Unproven. These separately reproduced product races do not establish that CI failure's cause.

linuxFollowUp.status: failed delayed-hello regression on both attempts; 192 other browser cases passed
linuxFollowUp.pushResult: 192 direct passes plus delayed-hello pass on configured retry
linuxFollowUp.cause: Unproven. Complete SDP exchange does not imply transport success. Local final-state-only diagnostics reproduced stable signaling with no local candidates on the polite endpoint and zero video traffic on either endpoint.
linuxFollowUp.diagnosticFollowUp: Final read-only RTP, track, DOM, gathering and candidate-count state without native API wrappers, SDP, candidate addresses, URLs or keys.

diagnosticCi.retryCase: Existing iPhone Manic video fold check; initial-camera test passed directly in both runs.

finalStateOnlyLocal.failedEndpointState: Both stable signaling and gathering ICE; host 19 local/0 remote candidates, polite guest 0 local/0 remote candidates; zero RTP and decoded remote video.

transportFinalOnlyLocal.credentialComparison: Unavailable in this Chromium, including in the successful case; no native transport/SDP mismatch is established.
transportFinalOnlyLocal.remoteCandidateMethodLimitation: Returned zero even in the successful case; not evidence of remote-candidate loss.
transportFinalOnlyLocal.standaloneComparison: Five native-only empty-ICE-server trials did not reproduce the failure. They do not match the app STUN/network configuration.

pendingRemoteOfferFollowUp.operation: Hold a real createOffer result, start native application of the other peer's valid offer, then release the local offer before native signaling state changes.
pendingRemoteOfferFollowUp.negativeControl: Old code called setLocalDescription(offer) from visible stable state into the pending remote-offer operation and received InvalidStateError; both peers later recovered before the no-rejection assertion failed.
pendingRemoteOfferFollowUp.fix: A per-PC remoteOfferPending flag blocks the obsolete local offer after createOffer and resets in setRemoteDescription finally.

nativeRecoveryExperiment.before: Stable SDP and sendrecv tracks on both peers; guest zero local candidates, host 19; no remote video or RTP.
nativeRecoveryExperiment.after: Renegotiation completed and roles flipped, but guest local candidates stayed zero; host local candidates rose to 38; ICE/DTLS remained new and no video flowed.

standaloneNativeControls.scope: Bounded controls did not reproduce the app startup failure; they do not establish an app-independent browser defect or disprove an ordering/timing problem.

initialOfferBarrierComparison.scope: A bounded scheduling comparison narrows the investigation; it is not yet a production fix, physical device or hosted camera acceptance.

supersedingFollowUp.scope: Historical failed/undeployed snapshots above remain unchanged; the combined follow-up passed local and exact Linux checks and is now deployed privately. Root cause and physical/forced-relay media acceptance remain separate.
